summary: Implemented hybrid structured logging, Prometheus /metrics (counter, histogram, urls_total gauge), three alert rules with runbooks, and completed the failure-first drill over ASGI without Postgres lifespan.
evidence: emit_log hybrid: development pretty line includes timestamp, INFO, message, service_name=url-shortener, request_id; production JSON required keys timestamp/level/message/service_name/request_id all present (PROD_JSON_REQUIRED_OK True).

ASGI drill (no lifespan): LIVE_STATUSES ten 200s for mixed /live and /health; HONORED_X_REQUEST_ID req-upstream-abc; DEBUG_ERROR_STATUS 500 with stack_trace RuntimeError: forced observability test error.

GET /metrics 200: http_requests_total{method="GET",path="/live",status="200"} 9.0; http_requests_total{method="GET",path="/debug/error",status="500"} 1.0; histogram buckets present; urls_total gauge present.
Alerts written in progress/production-module4-alert-rules.yml: HighErrorRate 5% for 2m critical, HighLatencyP95 >2s for 3m warning, ServiceDown up==0 for 1m critical, each with a runbook file.
Limitation: SQLAlchemy engine.connect() to localhost:5432 hung and was killed; uvicorn startup still requires Postgres so live process scrape was not claimed.
